x-openregister._seedDataNote: Seed objects MOVED to lib/Settings/profiles/*.json (OpenSpec change seed-profiles). A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

ApprovalRoute.title: ApprovalRoute
ApprovalRoute.description: A REUSABLE sign-off route: an ordered sequence of actors a subject travels for approval. Independent of any one subject: it describes a sequence to be travelled, and the travelling instance is DecisionStage. Distinct from DecisionTemplate/ProcessTemplate, which answer a different question: what STATES a decision may be in and how it moves between them. A route answers WHO signs, in what order.

subjectType.title: Subject type
subjectType.description: What kind of thing travels this route (e.g. collegeadvies, raadsvoorstel). Free text: the subjects are owned by consuming apps, whose vocabularies this register cannot enumerate.

isDefault.title: Default route
isDefault.description: Whether this is the route chosen when a subject of this subjectType names none.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether this route may still be instantiated. A route already travelled by a subject is unaffected: its stages were copied at instantiation.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: The ordered steps. Copied into DecisionStage rows at instantiation, so editing a route never changes a route already in flight.

stageType.title: Stage type
stageType.description: What the step is for. `endorsement` is the parafering case: a sign-off that is not itself the decision.

actorType.title: Actor type
actorType.description: How `actor` resolves. `role` is resolved by the consuming context at instantiation; `person` and `body` name a stored object directly.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: Who acts at this step, read according to actorType. Empty means the step accepts any authenticated actor.

mandatory.title: Mandatory
mandatory.description: Whether this step must be taken. Defaults to TRUE: a step whose skippability is unstated is required, because the other default silently permits skipping every step nobody thought about.

ApprovalAction.title: ApprovalAction
ApprovalAction.description: An APPEND-ONLY record of what one actor did at one step of a sign-off route. Many rows per step: an advice, a return, a re-submission, a delegate acting under mandate. Never overwritten, and never deleted when a route is returned to an earlier step: a DecisionStage holds where a route IS, and these hold what happened, including the attempts a return undid. Collapsing the two loses exactly the history that makes a sign-off auditable.

subjectSchema.title: Subject schema
subjectSchema.description: The schema of the subject, so a consuming app's object can be identified without this register owning its type.

step.title: Step
step.description: The step this action was taken at.

actorType.title: Actor type
actorType.description: Whether the actor acted for themselves or under a mandate for someone else.

onBehalfOf.title: On behalf of
onBehalfOf.description: The principal, when actorType is delegate.

mandate.title: Mandate
mandate.description: Reference to the mandate the delegate acted under.

action.title: Action
action.description: What was done. `returned` sends the route back to an earlier step; every other value completes the current one.

returnToStep.title: Return to step
returnToStep.description: For a `returned` action: the earlier step to re-open. Must be before the active step.

comment.title: Comment
comment.description: The actor's reason. Expected for a return or a skip, where the reason is the point.
